is_anopheles.evidence: A total of 214 Anopheles mosquitoes were analysed from 13 islands across the Bijagós. (Abstract)

reports_target_markers.evidence: Of the 17 screened mutations, four were identified in mosquitoes from the Bijagós: vgsc L995F (12.2%), N1570Y (6.2%) and A1746S (0.7%) and rdl A269G (1.1%). (Abstract)

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotype frequencies (%) and the number of mosquitoes/alleles genotyped (N) for markers including Vgsc L995F, N1570Y, and Rdl A296G. Tables 4 and 5 provide allelic frequencies with sample sizes per island and species.

african_field_population.evidence: These mosquitoes were collected using CDC light traps in November 2019... from 13 islands across the Bijagós [Guinea-Bissau]. (Abstract and Methods)

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting the first genomic surveillance of insecticide resistance markers on the Bijagós Archipelago.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is reported for 13 specific islands: Bubaque, Canhabaque (Roxa), Canogo, Caravela, Formosa, Tchedega, Meneque, Nhago (Ponta), Orangozinho, Rubane, Soga, Uno and Uracane. (Table 1, Figure 1)

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper mentions that the 214 mosquitoes are a subset of 409 collected during a cross-sectional survey (Soubrier et al., unpublished data), but the genotype data presented here appears primary to this publication.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype frequencies and sample sizes for the target markers are provided in the main text tables (Tables 3, 4, and 5).

assessment.summary: This study reports the prevalence of insecticide resistance markers (Vgsc L995F, N1570Y, and Rdl A296G) in Anopheles melas, An. gambiae s.s., and An. coluzzii from 13 islands of the Bijagós Archipelago, Guinea-Bissau. Samples were collected in November 2019. The study provides the first report of the L995F mutation in An. melas on the archipelago and provides detailed genotype and allele frequencies by island and species.
